items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Snookum Russell had a band of his own, all right. Snookum Russell come out of... He's not from your oldest, is he? Yeah. Florida, he's from Florida.

ctx.x: Well, there's so many guys came out of that band. And Snookum Russell had a big band one time too.

Snookum Russell had a band of his own, all right. Snookum Russell come out of... He's not from your oldest, is he? Yeah. Florida, he's from Florida. Snookum Russell come out of... He's from... Oh, this man got killed in a bus in Ron Jackson, Mississippi. He's from over in the Bahama Islands. I can't imagine who that would be. That's the band Snookum Russell came out of. Snookum Russell used to sing. He used to be what they call in those days a scat singer. Snookum Russell wasn't no piano player. No. He was a bass…
Snookum Russell had a fine band. But his New Orleans musicians?
